accueil.intro: Prepare, send and track your signature envelopes.
referentiels.intro: Every list on the platform comes from these reference lists: a value added in the database appears here without redeploying.

inscription.intro: Enter your organization's name and your work email: a confirmation link will be sent to you.
inscription.domaineAide: For example example.com: your email must belong to this domain. Required for production.
inscription.envoyee: If this address can receive a request, a confirmation link has just been sent to it. It is valid for 24 hours.
inscription.dnsExplication: Publish this record in your domain's DNS zone, then start the check. Propagation can take a few minutes.
inscription.etape.a-valider: Domain proven. Your request awaits approval by our team; you will receive a portal invitation.
inscription.etape.acceptee: Your organization is created. A portal invitation has been sent to you as administrator.
inscription.etape.refusee: This request was rejected or has expired. You can make a new one.
inscription.etape.courriel-a-confirmer: Confirm your address with the link you received by email.
inscription.erreur: The request could not be completed. Check the information and try again.
inscription.erreur.domaine-non-prouve: The DNS record is not visible yet. Try again in a few minutes.
inscription.erreur.inscription-fermee: Self-service sign-up is not open on this platform.
inscription.erreur.inscription-introuvab: This link is not valid. Please make a new request.
inscription.erreur.inscription-invalide: Information rejected: the email must be valid and belong to the given domain, and the link must not have expired.
connexion.intro: Sign in with your organization account to open this screen.
connexion.role: Your account does not have the role this screen requires. Ask your organization administrator for it.
connexion.indisponible: Sign-in is not configured on this portal.
facturation.aucun: No paid subscription: your organization uses the base plan.
facturation.aidePaiement: Payment happens on our payment provider's secure page; no card data passes through VinaSign.
facturation.erreur: Billing could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
facturation.erreurPrestataire: The payment provider did not respond. Try again in a moment.

envoi.echec.depot: The document was refused: it must be a valid PDF or Word file, without active content, within the allowed size. Choose another one; the envelope stays a draft.
envoi.echec.signataires: The signers were refused: check names and emails. The envelope stays a draft.
envoi.echec.envoi: Sending failed. The envelope stays a draft; try again from the list.
document.erreur: The document could not be displayed. Reload the page or download it.
document.erreurEnveloppe: The envelope could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

placement.consigne: Choose the person and field type, then tap the spot on the document. Drag a field to move it, its blue corner to resize it; with the keyboard, use the arrow keys (with Shift for size).
placement.nombre: field(s) placed. A signer without a signature field gets one at the bottom of the last page.
placement.echec: Fields could not be saved or the envelope sent. The draft is kept; try again.
